_about: ACS mission and partnership offerings the matcher scores against. verify: V = read on an ACS page or ACS PDF on 2026-10-14; U = search result or third-party source, confirm before using externally; I = internal ACS term taken from Julio's own Stage 2 / v4 workbooks (confirm details with Mission Sales Enablement). pockets use the Capital Map Budget_Pocket vocabulary (Grant, Commercial, Payroll, Principal, Systems, Strategic). fns use the Capital_Function vocabulary. match = regex (case-insensitive) that detects this offering in a Stage 2 'Primary/Secondary offering' cell.

offerings.name: Transportation & Lodging restricted gift
offerings.what: Restricted gift to Road To Recovery rides and Hope Lodge nights in the partner's own community. The most tangible local story ACS has: $50 = one ride, $70 = one Hope Lodge night (Seattle Hope Lodge, 5601 6th Ave S).
offerings.notes: Corporate precedent: NADA Foundation committed $3M over 3 years to Road To Recovery (U, nada.org). Seattle Hope Lodge address and 50-mile/90-minute eligibility from WA 211 listing (U).

offerings.name: Hope Lodge support and in-kind lodging
offerings.what: Hotel room nights, meals, family-room refreshes and volunteer service at the Seattle Hope Lodge. Fits hospitality and food companies that can give product or rooms instead of cash.
offerings.range: In-kind; confirm how it counts toward goal
offerings.notes: The WA 211 listing says hotels around the state sometimes donate rooms. The employer guide lists Hope Lodge volunteer roles: make meals, provide entertainment, welcome guests (V, Cost of Cancer guide).

offerings.name: 24/7 helpline and patient navigation
offerings.what: Fund the 1-800-227-2345 helpline and ACS navigation. $25 connects one person to services. Pairs with digital-access and health-system partners.
offerings.notes: A 2022 Patient Navigation grant round was sponsored by Janssen (J&J) and Bristol Myers Squibb (U, cancerhealth.com).

offerings.name: ACS CARES app (volunteer and innovation)
offerings.what: Employees become virtual volunteers who message patients through the ACS CARES app. Julio's Microsoft plan adds an 'ACS CARES Innovation Lab' activity.
offerings.notes: Innovation Lab format is internal (I) from the v4 Opportunities tab.

offerings.name: Reach To Recovery and Cancer Survivors Network
offerings.what: Peer support: $25 matches a breast cancer patient with a trained survivor; $10 helps someone find support online.

offerings.name: CancerRisk360 wellness activation
offerings.what: Free online risk assessment for adults 18+ (family history, habits, screening history). Gives personal action steps and breast, cervical, colorectal, lung and prostate screening recommendations, plus a Screening Locator. Run it as an employee or customer campaign.
offerings.range: Engagement; pairs with a gift or sponsorship
offerings.notes: Pfizer is listed as a financial supporter of the tool (V). Employer packaging is not described on the page; confirm with MSE.

offerings.name: Employer toolkits and lunch & learns (Cost of Cancer)
offerings.what: Turnkey employer toolkits on common cancers, physical activity and healthy eating, plus the Cost of Cancer business case: 80% of employers rate cancer the top health-cost driver; early diagnosis saves $157k (breast) to $263k (lung) per case.
offerings.notes: Use the stage-I vs stage-IV savings table with HR and benefits leaders.

offerings.name: Employer screening program (ACS + Color Health)
offerings.what: Employer or union enrolls; employees get at-home screening, navigation and care advocacy; the employer sees aggregate screening rates.
offerings.notes: Announced June 2023; current terms not confirmed.

offerings.name: Health equity screening grants (CHANGE) and Health Equity Ambassadors
offerings.what: Fund screening access in underserved communities. CHANGE grants (typically $75k to community health centers) and 4,000+ trained Health Equity Ambassadors who deliver prevention education.
offerings.notes: Ambassadors and the equity partnership model are from the ACS B2B flyer (V). CHANGE grant sizes and the NFL Crucial Catch funding are from press coverage (U).

offerings.name: ACS national roundtables (colorectal, lung, HPV, breast, cervical, prostate, navigation)
offerings.what: Corporate members and sponsors join coalitions that move screening rates nationally. A fit for pharma, diagnostics and insurers.
offerings.range: Sponsor-level; e.g. AstraZeneca funded lung roundtable at $1.5M over 3 yrs (2017)

offerings.name: Research gift / named research (Partnership for Mission Impact)
offerings.what: Direct funding of ACS research (ACS has invested $5.5B+ over 75 years). Internal naming vehicles in Julio's files: EDS naming and CICRT cohort naming (confirm with MSE).
offerings.notes: EDS / CICRT naming are internal terms (I) from Stage 2.

offerings.name: ResearcHERS (women leaders fund women-led research)
offerings.what: Women business leaders each raise funds for women-led cancer research. Companies sponsor the campaign or back an executive.

offerings.name: Gold Together (childhood cancer)
offerings.what: ACS childhood cancer initiative: research, advocacy and patient support; September Champions campaign and Relay teams.

offerings.name: ACS BrightEdge (impact investing)
offerings.what: ACS's evergreen impact fund invests in oncology therapeutics, diagnostics, devices and tech. The life-science 'Targeted Growth' door: co-investment, innovation sponsorship, Founder's Circle.
offerings.range: Founder's Circle and sponsorships (e.g. $1.5M sponsorship, 2025, U)
offerings.notes: Engage BrightEdge/national development before discussing investment structures (Framework crosswalk).

offerings.name: ACS CAN corporate membership
offerings.what: Corporate members engage on cancer policy with ACS CAN. Tiers in an undated brochure: $5k, $10k, $25k, $50k, $100k (Champions get an annual meeting with ACS CAN leadership).

offerings.name: Cost of Cancer in Rural Communities sponsorship
offerings.what: Sponsorship of ACS CAN rural cost-of-cancer work (internal offering in Julio's Stage 2, $25k, c4 caveat).
offerings.notes: Check KPI treatment for c4 money first.

offerings.name: Workplace giving: payroll, matching, platform presence
offerings.what: Payroll deduction, matching gifts and Charity of Choice / Featured Charity status. On Benevity or YourCause this is eligibility and presence, not a proposal.

offerings.name: Volunteer grants and campus activations
offerings.what: Employees volunteer with ACS (Hope Lodge, Road To Recovery driving, ACS CARES, event days) and the company pays volunteer-grant dollars. Basis of Julio's Microsoft 'One Hour a Month to End Cancer' ($25 per eligible hour).

offerings.name: Micro Campaigns
offerings.what: Short-term employee fundraisers on a customized mobile platform, run with the company.

offerings.name: Fit2Be Cancer Free step challenge
offerings.what: Mobile step challenge (MoveSpring app) where CEOs and employees race while meeting the company's giving goal. Past runs in spring and October.

offerings.name: Designated beneficiary in an employee campaign
offerings.what: Become a named co-cause in a company's annual employee campaign (often United Way-led). Owner direction usually decides.

offerings.name: Cause marketing (charitable sales promotion)
offerings.what: A share of each purchase goes to ACS. ACS says a minimum contribution level and guidelines apply, with brand and legal review. Julio's crosswalk cites a $25k draft minimum (confirm).

offerings.name: Point-of-sale / round-up campaign
offerings.what: Customers donate or round up at checkout; proceeds go to ACS. Native to grocers, restaurants and co-ops.

offerings.name: Brand licensing
offerings.what: The company pays a royalty to use ACS brand marks on products.

offerings.name: Making Strides Against Breast Cancer (Seattle) team or sponsorship
offerings.what: October walk. Corporate teams, sponsorship tiers and Men Wear Pink ambassadors.
offerings.notes: Watch for Komen as incumbent in the breast lane (PCC).

offerings.name: Relay For Life team or sponsorship
offerings.what: Community Relay events (e.g. Tacoma-Puget Sound) plus Gold Together teams.

offerings.name: Gala sponsorship or table (Seattle Hope Gala, Everett Night of Hope)
offerings.what: Seattle Hope Gala is described as WA's largest ACS fundraiser (contact Tina.Burns@cancer.org). Night of Hope Everett Gala is listed for Oct 30, 2026 at Tulalip Resort.
offerings.notes: Everett date from everett.acsgala.org search snippet (U). The Fluke 'Everett Gala line' likely refers to this event; confirm.

offerings.name: Washington Golf Classic sponsorship
offerings.what: ACS WA Golf Classic at Sahalee (per your 2026 event file). Fits owner-led contractors and executive champions.

offerings.name: GenNow / Fork Cancer Seattle (young professionals)
offerings.what: ACS GenNow Seattle chapter's spring social fundraiser (4th annual was Mar 26, 2026).

offerings.name: CEOs Against Cancer / executive ambassador slate
offerings.what: Peer network of CEOs building a culture of health with ACS. A Pacific Northwest chapter is referenced in a 2023 source; current status unconfirmed. Use for Access and Anchor conversions.

offerings.name: National corporate recognition levels
offerings.what: Cumulative giving levels: Guardians $100k to $249k, Champions $250k to $499k, Pioneers $500k to $999k, up to Trailblazers $15M+. Useful when framing multi-year Anchor paths.

offerings.name: Giving-platform stand-up (Benevity, YourCause, BottleDrop Give)
offerings.what: Register ACS where the partner's money already flows: Benevity, YourCause, Bright Funds, or Oregon's BottleDrop Give. Eligibility and presence, not a solicitation.
offerings.notes: BottleDrop Earth Week Give grants were $500 (Apr 1, 2026 deadline); BottleDrop Fund is invitation-only through Oregon Community Foundation (U).
